highlights.title: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line
highlights.description: Anthropic's proposal requires evaluators to report any imminent risk to the Department of Commerce within 72 hours, after which the Department must present the evidence to a federal judge and await an order.

highlights.title: OnlyFans Creators Are Pissed That Meta Lets Muse Talk Dirty
highlights.description: Adult performers are questioning why Meta allows its AI agent to sext while restricting their social media accounts.

highlights.title: AI Trade Reversal Pierces Asia’s Star Picks-and-Shovels Stocks
highlights.description: A deepening selloff in US technology stocks is exposing a new vulnerability in Asia’s artificial intelligence trade: mounting financing costs could choke off the spending needed to sustain the boom, threatening earnings across a supply chain that has powered the region’s stock-market rally.

highlights.title: Circle defends USDC economics as stablecoin rivals court its partners with bigger cut
highlights.description: Coinbase, Circle’s largest USDC partner, also backs Open USD, a rival network that passes reserve income to partners after a management fee.
